reason: This is the only experiment on the immutable board, so it ranks first by default. The earlier attempt used inconsistent strides and was abstained; the revised 272-byte design is internally consistent if allocation, packing, both K-loop pointer advances, and rewinds all use that stride. Prior noisy measurements do not establish a cache bottleneck or predict a gain. The padding adds 8 KiB per active panel, so correctness risk is moderate and full-GEMM validation is essential. No ZA tile reuse proposal is present on the board.
